title: Brazil, 1964-1985: coup, decree and economic miracle
goal: I can tell how Brazil was governed between 1964 and 1985, using the passive with ser.
grammar: the passive with ser + past participle

items: I can say who was overthrown in 1964.
I can say what the decree of December 1968 allowed.
I can say what the economic miracle was.
